messages.subject: Protein selection for groupComparison
parts:
Hey the MSstats Team !

It is maybe a stupid question but...
I can't figure out if it is posible to select proteins for the groupComparison or during the DataProcess... 
I would like to keep proteins which are present in at least 50% of the runs in at least one group/condition, it is that posible ? Is there any proteins selection already included in the groupComparison or the DataProcess function ?

Thak you very much for your help !

messages.author: 6597c45f2a31b5d0
messages.subject: Re: Protein selection for groupComparison
parts:
Hi,

MSstats does not offer that functionality out of the box, but you can adjust your R script to filter MSstats results based on proteins present in at least 50% of the runs in at least one group/condition.  Below is some starter code that you can adjust based on your specific needs.

library(tidyverse)
QuantData = dataProcess(input) # process data
groups = QuantData$ProteinLevelData %>% group_by(GROUP) %>% summarise(total_replicates = n_distinct(RUN), .groups = 'drop') # get total number of runs in each group
group_proteins = QuantData$ProteinLevelData %>% group_by(Protein, GROUP) %>% summarise(total_measured = n_distinct(RUN), .groups = 'drop')  # get total number of runs that measure a protein for a specific group
group_protein_percentage <- group_proteins %>% left_join(groups, by = "GROUP") %>% mutate(percentage = total_measured / total_replicates * 100) # get percentage of runs that measure a specific protein for a particular group
proteins = group_protein_percentage %>% filter(percentage > 50) %>% select(Protein) %>% unique() # get list of proteins with at least 50% of runs in at least one group/condition
QuantData$ProteinLevelData = QuantData$ProteinLevelData %>% filter(Protein %in% proteins$Protein) # filter protein level data with protein list
QuantData$FeatureLevelData = QuantData$FeatureLevelData %>% filter(PROTEIN %in% proteins$Protein) # filter feature level data with protein list
result = groupComparison("pairwise", QuantData) # perform group comparison with filtered dataset


Anthony
